subject: game code: GC/1.3.2
evidence: Version set per target body (tools/compiler_probe.py --summary 10 over bfbbdecomp/bfbb d8e8eac, files in docs/compiler_profile/): iBoxIsectRay form 0x8000C1FC (109 words, iMath3.cpp, game_inline_off.flags) matches only 1.3.2 among 1.3, 1.3.2, 2.0, 2.0p1, 2.5, 2.6, 2.7. xMat3x3RMulVec form 0x8002E280 (25 words, zEntTrigger.cpp/xCamera.cpp, game_inline_off.flags only) and zSurfaceGetSlideStartAngle/StopAngle 0x800D2E9C/0x800D2E4C (20 words) match 1.3 and 1.3.2, not 2.x. HIPLBlockEnter 0x8002BBF4, xParGroupAddPar 0x80032610, xSGAddLoadClient 0x80038130, xSGAddSaveClient 0x80038258 (game.flags) match 1.3.2 through 2.7, not 1.3. Only the intersection identifies 1.3.2. 1.0-1.2.5n (game_no_gccinc.flags) fail 32 of 72 units; in the 40 that compile they find 7 single-hit bodies of 10+ words against 74 for 1.3.2. Counter-hits: xSG_sv_flipproc 0x80036D50 and zConditionalEventCB 0x80045C34 match only 1.3, read as inlining differences in bfbb's source (same unit as the 1.3-excluding xsavegame bodies). 1.3.2 is mwcceppc 2.4.2 build 81 (.comment 2.4.2; the -version banner reads 2.4.1 build 32). GC/1.3.2r is a community patch, not a release, and matches like 1.3.2. Function names identify probe source, not target names.
